title: metadata: a published object-extension fieldPatches label is served only by /layers; the package-less, base-named and list reads of the object keep the shipped label
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured contract break, found by the #28579 slice 3 run (run record #29560, PR #29559 `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §15b item 2). It was an off-clause probe beside `studio-authoring.package-extension-field-c`. The seat has not re-measured it.
Reader: `domain:server` (the object read in `packages/metadata-protocol`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `fieldPatches`. #29366 and #29523 are about the record key's spec shape, #28804 about skill evals, and #29554 about the conversions pass. None is about the served read.
reach: any published `fieldPatches` entry. Measured on `showcase_task` in `com.example.showcase.custom`.
type: Bug

## What happens
With a published object extension in the pair whose `fieldPatches` changes a base field's `label`, only `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_task/layers` shows the patched label. The read naming no package, the read naming the base (`?package=com.example.showcase`) and the type's list all serve the shipped label.

## Why it is wrong
ADR-0146 D10 lets a base field change within a display-property whitelist through the extension, and `registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts` pins every read serving the patch. The live boot disagrees with that pin, so either the pin's harness bypasses the path a booted stack reads, or the patch is dropped between the registry and the served read.

## Wanted
Every read of the base object serves the patched display properties once the extension is published, as the `__c` fields of the same extension already are. Add a pin over the path a booted stack takes, and find why the existing pin did not catch this.
